not-transmission: The service at this address answered, but not the way Transmission does.
too-old: This is Transmission {{version, vendor}}; the app needs Transmission 4.0 or newer. Update Transmission, then test again.
temporary-folder: Transmission keeps unfinished downloads in its temporary folder “{{folder, vendor}}”, where the app can't follow them. In Transmission's web interface open Edit preferences, Torrents, untick “Use temporary folder”, then test again.
sign-in-needed: Transmission asks for a user name and password. Enter them under Integrations.
forbidden: Transmission refused this app (403 Forbidden): this app's address isn't on its RPC whitelist (WHITELIST in the linuxserver image, rpc-whitelist in its settings), or it locked its RPC after too many wrong passwords, which only a restart of Transmission ends.
host-not-allowed: Transmission doesn't accept the host name in this address (421 Misdirected Request); it checks host names only while it has no password. Give Transmission a user name and password (USER and PASS in the linuxserver image), add the host name to its rpc-host-whitelist (HOST_WHITELIST), or use its IP address, then test again.
rpc-not-found: Transmission's RPC wasn't found at this address (404 Not Found). Use the address of Transmission's web interface, such as http://192.168.1.10:9091.
session-id-refused: Transmission refused the session id it had just sent.

remembered.credentials-refused: Transmission refused the user name or password the last time the app used them, so the app won't send them again: with its anti-brute-force setting on, every refusal counts towards locking its RPC. Correct them under Integrations, or test the connection there once Transmission accepts them.
remembered.sign-in-needed: Transmission asked for a user name and password the last time the app asked it, so the app won't ask again until they are entered under Integrations or the connection is tested there.
remembered.forbidden: Transmission refused this app the last time it asked (403 Forbidden), so the app won't ask it again until the connection is tested under Integrations.

folder.download-folder-unusable: Transmission's download folder “{{folder, vendor}}” isn't a full path the app can use. In Transmission's web interface open Edit preferences, Torrents, give “Download to” a full path such as /downloads, then look again.
folder.download-folder-too-long_one: Transmission's download folder “{{folder}}” is longer than the {{count, number}} character a destination can hold.
folder.download-folder-too-long_other: Transmission's download folder “{{folder}}” is longer than the {{count, number}} characters a destination can hold.
folder.too-long_one: The folder “{{folder}}” is longer than the {{count, number}} character a destination can hold.
folder.too-long_other: The folder “{{folder}}” is longer than the {{count, number}} characters a destination can hold.
folder.not-seen: {{service}} can't see “{{folder}}” ({{reason, vendor}}). Mount that folder into {{service}}, or add a path mapping on this integration that leads there, then look again.
folder.not-seen-no-free-space: {{service}} can't see “{{folder}}” (no free space reported). Mount that folder into {{service}}, or add a path mapping on this integration that leads there, then look again.

add.duplicate: Transmission already has this torrent, so it added nothing.
add.duplicate-no-label: Transmission already has this torrent, in “{{folder, vendor}}” with no label, so it added nothing.
add.duplicate-labelled: Transmission already has this torrent, in “{{folder, vendor}}” with the label “{{labels, vendor}}”, so it added nothing.
add.v2-only: Transmission can't take a torrent that is BitTorrent v2 only, which this release is, so nothing was sent.
